page_title: FIO 1-1 INT | Fiorentina v Inter 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom right corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out.
90+2' Manuel Akanji (Inter) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert David de Gea. What a save!
90+1' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) replaces Albert Gudmundsson.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolo Fagioli cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter). Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Total attempts – 16:10.
86' Here's the change. Denzel Dumfries leaves the pitch and Luis Henrique (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
86' Here is a change. Moise Kean is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
85' Davide Frattesi (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dodo (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
83' That will be all from Nicolo Barella who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Petar Sucic (Inter).
82' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
82' Davide Frattesi (Inter) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
82' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:1.
76' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

76' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
73' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
72' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Yann Sommer has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
69' Substitution. Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fabiano Parisi walks off.
69' Aleksandar Kolarov prepares a substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Thuram departs the field of play to be replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
65' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
65' An attempted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is cleared.
62' Nicolo Barella (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Manuel Akanji (Inter) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
61' The game is interrupted now, Manuel Akanji (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' Marcus Thuram (Inter) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
58' It will be a corner kick for Inter.
58' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
55' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
55' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
54' A pass from Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Yann Sommer and the move breaks down.
53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
51' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
48' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' Substitution. Francesco Acerbi (Inter) replaces Carlos Augusto.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is caught offside!
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Yellow card. Carlos Augusto (Inter) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
42' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Federico Dimarco (Inter) for his blatant foul.
41' The total number of attempts is 7:4.
39' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!
37' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yann Sommer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
34' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
33' Federico Dimarco (Inter) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Good work from Inter as they win a corner.
32' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
29' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Moise Kean.
29' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fiorentina win a corner.
26' 40:60 – the latest ball possession ratio.
24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
23' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
19' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
19' Federico Dimarco (Inter) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Nicolo Barella, but David de Gea displays great awareness to stop him.
18' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

16' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Yann Sommer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
15' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
14' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
12' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
11' Neat passing move from Fiorentina in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nicolo Barella (Inter) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
6' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

1' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Nicolo Barella and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. David de Gea was helpless.
